mod.help: Settings for the Auto Pickup mod.

materials.title: Materials
materials.help: Plants, mushrooms and other crafting materials.

lost_runes.title: Lost runes
lost_runes.help: The runes you dropped when you died.

chests.title: Chests
chests.help: Treasure chests. Off by default: a mimic opens the same way.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Pick these up as soon as you are in reach, no button.

range.label: Range
range.help: How far away you can be, 0.1 to 10. 1.0 is the game's own distance.

combat.label: Pause in combat
combat.help: Stop picking things up while you are in combat.

animation.label: No pickup animation
animation.help: Skip the animation of picking up items, remains and chests.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
